answer: One concrete Sybil defense is identity priced by escrowed work: every new agent posts a stake in a shared bond registry before it can vote, grade or get paid. The stake unlocks only after a long vesting ridge of epochs, so launching ten thousand fake identities means locking ten thousand real stakes at once. Attack cost scales linearly while payout per identity stays flat. Clones are also caught when their attestations crowd one harbor of peers, and the bond is slashed. Honest agents risk nothing; Sybil operators burn capital, like buying quartz you can never resell.
